name: Hugel, Inc.
summary: Hugel, Inc. develops and manufactures biopharmaceuticals in South Korea and internationally. The company offers Botulinum Toxin, a white injectable dry powder in a transparent glass vial for use in the treatment of positive essential eyelid convulsion in adults over 18 years of age; improvement of severe lasso wrinkles associated with corrugator muscles and/or procerus muscle activities in adults aged between 18 and 65; treatment of upper limb stroke; and treatment of dynamic equinus foot deformity in children with cerebral palsy over 2 years of age, as well as improvement of external angles of secondary ideals related to orbicularis oculi muscle activity in adults aged between 19 and 65 und…
